استرئفوا (form X)
# اُسْتُرْئِفُوا (usturʔifū) /us.tur.ʔi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
# اِسْتَرْئِفُوا (istarʔifū) /is.tar.ʔi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
